question: Hello Oda-sensei! Momonosuke is 8 years old, sensei, why is he so perverted? Is Oda-sensei the same?
answer: The question is, when do boys get so pervy? I'm trying to keep this a secret! Because if you make this public, they won't be able to use their "privileges"!! I won't open my mouth!!
name: Yu-kun
